name: Never Stop Turning AZ 2023
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NeverStopTurningAZ2023#20712-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/380588094020424/) to hear about competitions in Arizona before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!
